// REQ: LANG-2221 LANG-2222 LANG-2223 LANG-2224
module demo
/* Effects */
effect ask
  ctl ask() : int
fun greet(name : string, times : int) : console ()
  for(1, times) fn(i)
    println("Hello, " ++ name ++ "!")
fun main()
  with handler
    ctl ask() resume(21)
  val x = ask() + ask()
  if x > 0 && True then greet("koka", 2)
